title: Networked AI: Architecture, Theory, and Applications
title_zh: 网络化 AI：架构、理论与应用

paragraphs.en: 提出网络化AI分层架构与统一理论框架,实现更高数据效率、在线适应与可扩展集体智能。 Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly large-scale deep learning, have been driven by monolithic or offline training on massive curated datasets. While successful, these approaches face structural limitations: escalating data and computational demands, limited online adaptability, and a lack of system-level intelligence in open, non-stationary environments. This paper presents Networked AI - a networked intelligent system composed of interacting, heterogeneous, and continuously evolving AI agents. We establish a hierarchical layered architecture comprising an Agent Layer for heterogeneous capability construction, an Interaction Layer for signal-processing-guided online data extraction, and a Regulation Layer for stability-constrained collective evolution. Foundations in data science, signal processing, and system control are hereby synthesized into a unified theoretical framework of Networked AI, providing superior data efficiency, intelligence efficiency, interpretability, and scalability. Theoretical and experimental analysis demonstrates that Networked AI can approach near-linear scaling in resource demand, in contrast to the exponential increase in standalone end-to-end systems. It provides not only online adaptation to out-of-distribution environmental novelties, but also the autonomous evolution towards application-specific intelligence. Application frontiers are discussed for IoT spaces, embodied, spatial, and industrial intelligences, as well as the cellular infrastructure and beyond. Key open challenges are identified towards realizing locally autonomous, collectively intelligent, continuously evolving, globally regulated Networked AI.
paragraphs.zh: 提出网络化AI分层架构与统一理论框架，实现更高数据效率、在线适应与可扩展集体智能。人工智能（AI）的最新进展，尤其是大规模深度学习，是由对海量精选数据集进行单体化或离线训练所驱动的。 这些方法虽然成功，但面临结构性局限：数据与计算需求不断攀升、在线适应能力有限，以及在开放、非平稳环境中缺乏系统级智能。 本文提出网络化AI——一种由相互作用、异构且持续演化的智能体组成的网络化智能系统。 我们建立了一个分层架构，包括用于异构能力构建的智能体层、用于信号处理引导的在线数据提取的交互层，以及用于稳定性约束下集体演化的调控层。 本文将数据科学、信号处理与系统控制的基础融合为网络化AI的统一理论框架，提供更优的数据效率、智能效率、可解释性与可扩展性。 理论与实验分析表明，网络化AI的资源需求可接近线性扩展，而独立端到端系统则呈指数级增长。 它不仅提供对分布外环境新异性的在线适应，还实现面向特定应用智能的自主演化。 讨论了物联网空间、具身智能、空间智能与工业智能，以及蜂窝基础设施及更广泛领域的应用前沿。 指出了实现局部自治、集体智能、持续演化、全局调控的网络化AI所面临的关键开放挑战。
